buildkit 0.35.0

Welcome to the v0.35.0 release of buildkit!



Please try out the release binaries and report any issues at
https://github.com/moby/buildkit/issues.

### Contributors

* Tõnis Tiigi
* CrazyMax
* Sebastiaan van Stijn
* Zhizhen He
* Adam Stokes
* Christian Muertz
* Dean Chen

* Jonathan A. Sternberg

* Luca Landi

### Notable Changes


- Built-in Dockerfile frontend has been updated to v1.29.0 [changelog](https://github.com/moby/buildkit/releases/tag/dockerfile%2F1.29.0)
- Git command tracing can now be enabled with the `BUILDKIT_GIT_DEBUG_COMMANDS=1` build arg. #6588
- HTTP sources now retry transient failures and honor `Retry-After` headers. #7258 #7367
- Registry authentication now refreshes rejected credentials before retrying token requests. #7339
- Fix image cache invalidation when only attestations change. #7334
- Fix remote cache exports containing incomplete layer chains. #7351
- Fix cache matching with missing blobs or alternative input keys. #7364 #7312
- Fix incorrect warning logs from session healthchecks #7401
- Fix empty layer array in image config for layerless images #7343 
- Fix possible resource leak in GHA cache readers #7374
- Fix concurrent local cache imports contending for ingest locks. #7187
- Fix local cache exports ignoring `ignore-error` when publishing the index. #7309
- Fix partial reads and resumed download failures in the S3 cache backend. #7363 #7361
- Fix GitHub Actions cache signature verification ignoring configured transparency log thresholds. #7304
- Fix cache record leaks and cleanup after canceled builds. #7264 #7157 #7355 #7354 #7325
- Fix cache finalization being lost when a build is canceled. #7332
- Fix on-demand CDI device resolution and permission checks. #7293
- Fix failed NVIDIA signing key imports preventing retries. #7298
- Fix frontend startup failures by waiting before the HTTP/2 handshake and allowing more time for containers to start. #7336
- Fix gateway exec hangs and lost process errors when streams close. #7300
- Fix frontend file descriptor leaks and double release of failed exec references. #7337 #7348
- Fix oversized build status messages by batching according to encoded size. #7340
- Fix races in build progress, cache access, provenance, and exporters. #7256 #7277 #7322 #7325 #7338 #7294
- Fix authorization failures leaving request bodies open. #7284
- Fix rootless builds with process sandboxing disabled creating a new keyring. #7311
